record.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #068: Anticanonical nonvanishing in every dimension.

Source-faithful audit of the seven September 26, 2026 OpenAI family 068 manuscripts. Assertions in the graph are audit targets, not accepted theorems; known literature inputs are recorded separately. The bounded mission decides the full toroidal-volume theorem, not the headline nonvanishing problem.

record.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 068 (Anticanonical nonvanishing in every dimension.; papers: Anticanonical nonvanishing from smooth semipositivity; Invariant anticanonical indices and conversion of twisted differentials; Bounded anticanonical metrics on klt pairs and torus quotients; Cohomological transfer and equivariant anticanonical sections; Metric descent and rank-preserving contractions; Integrable metrics and effectivity with controlled boundary; Exact orders and invariant anticanonical linear systems; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

Decide the complete toroidal volume metric theorem (g:toroidal-volume), including all-valuation integrability, boundary extension, and conditional local strictness; a refutation must satisfy every hypothesis.
An explicit geometric counterexample to a literal toroidal-volume assertion satisfies all hypotheses of that assertion. This is a research obligation, not an assertion that a witness exists.

For every smooth connected projective complex variety X whose anticanonical bundle admits a smooth semipositive Hermitian metric, H^0(X,-mK_X) is nonzero for some integer m>0 (H, thm:headline). Alternative proofs are recorded as separate routes, not simultaneous prerequisites.

If Z is smooth connected projective with H^0(Z,Omega_Z^q)=0 for all q>0, D is effective integral, -K_Z+D has a semipositive singular metric with finite canonical-section measure, and L has locally bounded semipositive weights, then H^0(Z,aL+bD) is nonzero for some integers a>0,b>=0 (H, thm:finite-volume).

The finite-adjoint-volume slope estimate used in H controls cotangent determinants on a supporting movable class and permits the dimension induction; this is a source-specific audit obligation, not an assumed consequence of nefness.

The H orbit-transfer argument produces a naturally torus-invariant section of a positive anticanonical multiple on its smooth no-positive-forms factor, using invariant adjoint ranks and compact averaging rather than the full-rank volume theorem.
The finite-cover compact-torus-monodromy structure in H retains the deck action on the universal-cover factors; it is not a global-product assertion for a finite cover.
A nonzero section of a positive tensor power of a pulled-back line on a finite etale cover gives a nonzero section of a positive tensor power on the base by the finite etale norm.

For a holomorphic action of a compact real torus T on a compact complex manifold F and the natural anticanonical linearization, I_T(m)=sum_q(-1)^q dim H^q(F,(-K_F)^m)^T agrees with a rational polynomial P at every positive multiple of some a>0, and P(0)=I_T(0); no positivity, Kahlerness, or projectivity is assumed (I, thm:index).

If S is smooth connected projective, L=-K_S is smoothly semipositive, D is a fixed pseudoeffective Cartier divisor, and H^0(S,m_jL-D) is nonzero along a strictly increasing positive sequence, then H^0(S,kL) is nonzero for some k>0 (I, thm:conversion).

For a projective Q-factorial klt pair (W,D) with effective rational boundary, nef P=-(K_W+D), and a smooth projective resolution rho on which rho^*P has locally bounded semipositive weights and chi(O) is nonzero, a positive Cartier multiple of P has a nonzero section (B, thm:klt).

If Z is smooth rationally connected projective and -K_Z is smoothly semipositive, every algebraic torus acting on Z has a naturally invariant section of some positive anticanonical multiple (B, thm:equivariant). Its stable-quotient metric and extension are separate obligations from toroidal volume.

For smooth connected projective X with smoothly semipositive L=-K_X and an algebraic torus action, let P=L as ordinary lines with any linearization and let M be linearized with -M pseudoeffective. Nonzero invariant sections of M+iP for an unbounded positive set of i imply a nonzero invariant section of mP for some m>0 (C, inj:transfer).

For the C harmonic mechanism, f:V->Y is a surjective morphism of smooth projective varieties, D_V has a smooth semipositive metric whose null directions are vertical on a nonempty submersion open, and Q has a continuous semipositive metric on Y. Then H^p(Y,R^q f_*(K_V+D_V) tensor Q^k)=0 for p>0 and q,k>=0. This is an alternative mechanism, not an input to g:toroidal-volume.

Let X,Y be smooth connected projective complex varieties with dim Y>0, L=-K_X smoothly semipositive, p:W->X projective birational, and f:W->Y projective surjective equidimensional toroidal for strict embeddings, with W normal integral. For a smooth resolution rho:Z->W, pi=p rho, g=f rho, E_Z=K_{Z/X}, assume rank g_*O_Z(E_Z)=1. Set a_Q=max(0,min_{E->Q}((1+ord_E K_{W/X})/ord_E f^*Q-1)), A_0=sum a_Q Q. Then A_0 is finite effective rational, f^*A_0 is p-exceptional, and -K_Y+A_0 has a semipositive singular metric with unweighted locally integrable squared frame norms, smooth on a nonempty Zariski open. If pi^*alpha>=c g^*omega_Y on a nonempty ordinary patch in the smooth base-change locus away from E_Z, the constructed metric is strictly positive on a nonempty ordinary base open (G, g:toroidal-volume).

Under the morphism and model hypotheses of g:toroidal-volume, but without a metric or rank assumption, Theta=-K_{W/X}+f^*A_0 is nonpositive, (W,Theta) is sub-klt, and f^*A_0 is p-exceptional. Every prime F on every smooth model tau:Z'->W has coeff_F(K_{Z'/X}-(f tau)^*A_0)>-1 (G, g:volume-subklt).

With the full generic adjoint rank at exponent zero equal to one, the Jacobian section identifies the entire smooth adjoint direct image with -K_Y on a smaller base-change open, and its L2 frame norm equals the pushed-forward smooth anticanonical volume density. Smooth direct-image positivity makes the negative logarithm psh; no arbitrary subline restriction is used.

The corrected weight Phi=-log H+sum a_Q log|t_Q|^2 extends psh across every omitted divisor using the minimizing transverse branch, then across codimension at least two by Hartogs removability; projection of the corrected upstairs measure and g:volume-subklt prove unweighted local integrability.

In g:toroidal-volume the single horizontal-curvature patch away from E_Z implies positive definite curvature of the smooth density metric on a nonempty ordinary base open, via the primitive-representative curvature formula, including the relative-dimension-zero case.

For g:transfer, two semipositive metrics, finite canonical-section volume, a rational relative section without horizontal poles on a normal equidimensional model, and the two explicitly assumed psh fiber functions produce a bounded base line metric and an integral controlled-pole adjoint measure. Full-rank-one and invariant-quotient sufficient conditions must not be conflated.

For smooth connected projective no-positive-forms X with smoothly semipositive -K_X and a torus, a T-invariant rational fibration with relatively algebraically closed base field, a generic positive anticanonical invariant section, and invariant generic adjoint rank one at all positive multiples of one integer either gives a global invariant section or contracts through a strictly smaller smooth projective base retaining both conditions and relative algebraic closedness (G, g:cf:contraction-theorem).

If Y is smooth projective of positive dimension, C>=0 is integral, and -K_Y+C has a singular metric with curvature dominating a Kahler form and multiplier ideal containing O_Y(-C), then every pseudoeffective rational divisor M becomes rationally effective after adding an effective rational divisor supported on C (E, thm:controlled-boundary).

If -K_Y+A_0 on smooth positive-dimensional projective Y has a semipositive singular metric with unweighted integrable squared frame norms, smooth and strictly positive on a nonempty ordinary open, then for any finite list of rational divisors P_i some common rational epsilon>0 and k_0>0 give Cartier B_i=k_0(A_0+epsilon P_i) whose actual multigraded section ring is finitely generated (E, thm:correction-ring).

E obtains ordinary fixed-pseudoeffective-error conversion for smoothly semipositive -K_X. Its main singular globally-strict metric route and its smooth toroidal/unweighted route are alternatives; failure of g:toroidal-volume alone does not refute the main conversion or headline nonvanishing.

For smooth connected positive-dimensional projective X with smoothly semipositive L=-K_X of maximum curvature rank nu and ample G_0, put ell(D)=D.L^nu.G_0^(n-nu-1) when nu<n and ell=0 otherwise. For any fixed line M, any centered discrete valuation v of C(X) or v=0, and effective integral N_j~m_j L+M with m_j->infinity, ell(N_j)=0 and v(N_j)/m_j->0, there is effective rational N~_Q L with v(N)=0 (V, V:exact).

The V null-polar-field construction supplies a normal equidimensional toroidal model with full generic adjoint rank one at exponent zero and a patch of horizontal curvature domination, as required by g:toroidal-volume. This application interface remains a separate obligation from that theorem.

The V finite-generated-ring endpoint argument attains zero valuation in an actual rational-linear anticanonical representative after removing the exceptional correction; numerical limiting effectivity and a bounded finite search are not substitutes.

If X is smooth connected projective, -K_X is smoothly semipositive, and H^i(X,O_X)=0 for all i>0, then every algebraic torus action has a nonzero naturally invariant section of a positive anticanonical multiple (V, V:invariant-main).

With the full generic adjoint rank at exponent zero equal to one, the Jacobian section identifies the entire smooth adjoint direct image with -K_Y on a smaller base-change open, and its L2 frame norm equals the pushed-forward smooth anticanonical volume density. Smooth direct-image positivity makes the negative logarithm psh; no arbitrary subline restriction is used.

record.natural_statement: Under the full toroidal-volume hypotheses, let S be any finite set of toroidal base-boundary primes whose entire pullbacks are p-exceptional. Put lambda_Q=min_{E->Q}(1+a_E)/e_E, a_Q=max(0,lambda_Q-1). For rational b_Q>=0, the density metric on -K_Y+A_0+sum b_Q Q extends semipositively and retains the original smoothness and conditional local strictness. Its squared frame norms are locally integrable on all of Y if and only if b_Q<min(lambda_Q,1) for every Q in S. In this range the corrected pair is sub-klt at every divisorial valuation. Endpoints already fail at a prime on W. This is a proposed independently proved structural refinement; novelty and publication-level significance remain unverified.

Universal algebraic core of the toroidal-volume audit: in every finite matrix dimension a single logarithmic polar row gives at most a simple determinant pole; for arbitrary nonnegative discrepancies and multiplicities at least one, the clipped-minimum correction is nonpositive as a boundary and vanishes on a nonexceptional branch; for any attained minimum, strict codimension-one integrability is equivalent to the sharp correction interval; a log-canonical discrepancy plus a nonnegative full-support Cartier contribution is strictly positive on every valuation. This claim does not itself formalize complex varieties, measures, direct images, or analytic extension.

record.formal_statement:
import Mathlib

namespace ToroidalVolumeAudit

open Matrix

theorem cleared_logarithmic_determinant
    {I R : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [CommRing R]
    (A : Matrix I I R) (k : I) (m : I → R) (t : R) :
    (A.updateRow k (m + t • A k)).det =
      (A.updateRow k m).det + t * A.det := by
  rw [Matrix.det_updateRow_add, Matrix.det_updateRow_smul,
    Matrix.updateRow_eq_self]

theorem at_most_simple_logarithmic_pole
    {I K : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Field K]
    (A : Matrix I I K) (k : I) (m : I → K) (t : K) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    t * (A.updateRow k (A k + t⁻¹ • m)).det =
      t * A.det + (A.updateRow k m).det := by
  rw [Matrix.det_updateRow_add, Matrix.det_updateRow_smul,
    Matrix.updateRow_eq_self]
  calc
    t * (A.det + t⁻¹ * (A.updateRow k m).det) =
        t * A.det + (t * t⁻¹) * (A.updateRow k m).det := by ring
    _ = t * A.det + (A.updateRow k m).det := by
      rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ ht, one_mul]

def correction (lam : ℚ) : ℚ := max 0 (lam - 1)

def room (lam : ℚ) : ℚ := min lam 1

theorem correction_nonnegative (lam : ℚ) : 0 ≤ correction lam :=
  le_max_left _ _

theorem room_identity (lam : ℚ) : lam - correction lam = room lam := by
  unfold correction room
  by_cases h : lam ≤ 1
  · rw [max_eq_left (by linarith), min_eq_left h]
    ring
  · rw [max_eq_right (by linarith), min_eq_right (by linarith)]
    ring

theorem correction_bounded_by_jacobian
    (a e lam : ℚ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (he : 1 ≤ e)
    (hmin : e * lam ≤ a + 1) :
    e * correction lam ≤ a := by
  unfold correction
  by_cases h : lam ≤ 1
  · rw [max_eq_left (by linarith), mul_zero]
    exact ha
  · rw [max_eq_right (by linarith)]
    nlinarith

theorem nonexceptional_branch_forces_zero
    (e lam : ℚ) (he : 1 ≤ e) (hmin : e * lam ≤ 1) :
    correction lam = 0 := by
  have hlam : lam ≤ 1 := by
    by_contra h
    have hpos : 0 < e := by linarith
    have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (show 1 < lam by linarith) hpos
    nlinarith
  exact max_eq_left (by linarith)

theorem minimum_positive
    {I : Type*} (a e : I → ℚ) (lam : ℚ)
    (ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) (he : ∀ i, 0 < e i)
    (hatt : ∃ i, e i * lam = a i + 1) :
    0 < lam := by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hatt
  have hnum : 0 < a i + 1 := by linarith [ha i]
  have hprod : 0 < e i * lam := by linarith
  exact (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left (he i)).mp hprod

theorem positive_room (lam : ℚ) (hlam : 0 < lam) : 0 < room lam :=
  lt_min hlam (by norm_num)

theorem sharp_prime_threshold
    {I : Type*} (a e : I → ℚ) (lam b : ℚ)
    (he : ∀ i, 0 < e i)
    (hmin : ∀ i, e i * lam ≤ a i + 1)
    (hatt : ∃ i, e i * lam = a i + 1) :
    (∀ i, -1 < a i - e i * (correction lam + b)) ↔ b < room lam := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hatt
    have hmul : e i * (correction lam + b) < e i * lam := by
      linarith [h i]
    have hc : correction lam + b < lam :=
      (mul_lt_mul_left (he i)).mp hmul
    rw [← room_identity]
    linarith
  · intro hb i
    rw [← room_identity] at hb
    have hc : correction lam + b < lam := by linarith
    have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hc (he i)
    linarith [hmin i]

theorem full_support_discrepancy
    {V : Type*} (lc cartier : V → ℚ)
    (hlc : ∀ v, 0 ≤ lc v)

  intro v
  by_cases h : lc v = 0

import Mathlib

namespace ToroidalVolumeAudit

open Matrix

theorem cleared_logarithmic_determinant
    {I R : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [CommRing R]
    (A : Matrix I I R) (k : I) (m : I → R) (t : R) :
    (A.updateRow k (m + t • A k)).det =
      (A.updateRow k m).det + t * A.det := by
  rw [Matrix.det_updateRow_add, Matrix.det_updateRow_smul,
    Matrix.updateRow_eq_self]

theorem at_most_simple_logarithmic_pole
    {I K : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Field K]
    (A : Matrix I I K) (k : I) (m : I → K) (t : K) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    t * (A.updateRow k (A k + t⁻¹ • m)).det =
      t * A.det + (A.updateRow k m).det := by
  rw [Matrix.det_updateRow_add, Matrix.det_updateRow_smul,
    Matrix.updateRow_eq_self]
  calc
    t * (A.det + t⁻¹ * (A.updateRow k m).det) =
        t * A.det + (t * t⁻¹) * (A.updateRow k m).det := by ring
    _ = t * A.det + (A.updateRow k m).det := by
      rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ ht, one_mul]

def correction (lam : ℚ) : ℚ := max 0 (lam - 1)

def room (lam : ℚ) : ℚ := min lam 1

theorem correction_nonnegative (lam : ℚ) : 0 ≤ correction lam :=
  le_max_left _ _

theorem room_identity (lam : ℚ) : lam - correction lam = room lam := by
  unfold correction room
  by_cases h : lam ≤ 1
  · rw [max_eq_left (by linarith), min_eq_left h]
    ring
  · rw [max_eq_right (by linarith), min_eq_right (by linarith)]
    ring

theorem correction_bounded_by_jacobian
    (a e lam : ℚ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (he : 1 ≤ e)
    (hmin : e * lam ≤ a + 1) :
    e * correction lam ≤ a := by
  unfold correction
  by_cases h : lam ≤ 1
  · rw [max_eq_left (by linarith), mul_zero]
    exact ha
  · rw [max_eq_right (by linarith)]
    nlinarith

theorem nonexceptional_branch_forces_zero
    (e lam : ℚ) (he : 1 ≤ e) (hmin : e * lam ≤ 1) :
    correction lam = 0 := by
  have hlam : lam ≤ 1 := by
    by_contra h
    have hpos : 0 < e := by linarith
    have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (show 1 < lam by linarith) hpos
    nlinarith
  exact max_eq_left (by linarith)

theorem minimum_positive
    {I : Type*} (a e : I → ℚ) (lam : ℚ)
    (ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) (he : ∀ i, 0 < e i)
    (hatt : ∃ i, e i * lam = a i + 1) :
    0 < lam := by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hatt
  have hnum : 0 < a i + 1 := by linarith [ha i]
  have hprod : 0 < e i * lam := by linarith
  exact (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left (he i)).mp hprod

theorem positive_room (lam : ℚ) (hlam : 0 < lam) : 0 < room lam :=
  lt_min hlam (by norm_num)

theorem sharp_prime_threshold
    {I : Type*} (a e : I → ℚ) (lam b : ℚ)
    (he : ∀ i, 0 < e i)
    (hmin : ∀ i, e i * lam ≤ a i + 1)
    (hatt : ∃ i, e i * lam = a i + 1) :
    (∀ i, -1 < a i - e i * (correction lam + b)) ↔ b < room lam := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hatt
    have hmul : e i * (correction lam + b) < e i * lam := by
      linarith [h i]
    have hc : correction lam + b < lam :=
      (mul_lt_mul_iff_right₀ (he i)).mp hmul
    rw [← room_identity]
    linarith
  · intro hb i
    rw [← room_identity] at hb
    have hc : correction lam + b < lam := by linarith
    have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hc (he i)
    linarith [hmin i]

theorem full_support_discrepancy
    {V : Type*} (lc cartier : V → ℚ)
    (hlc : ∀ v, 0 ≤ lc v)
    (hcartier : ∀ v, 0 ≤ cartier v)
    (hfull : ∀ v, lc v = 0 → 0 < cartier v) :
    ∀ v, 0 < lc v + cartier v := by
  intro v
  by_cases h : lc v = 0
  · linarith [hfull v h]
  · have hpos : 0 < lc v := lt_of_le_of_ne (hlc v) (Ne.symm h)
    linarith [hcartier v]

theorem klt_type_monotonicity
    {V : Type*} (klt effective : V → ℚ)
    (hklt : ∀ v, 0 < klt v)
    (heffective : ∀ v, 0 ≤ effective v) :
    ∀ v, 0 < klt v + effective v := by
  intro v
  exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (hklt v) (heffective v)

theorem blowup_endpoint (codim s : ℚ) :
    (-1 < (codim - 1) - (codim - 1 + s)) ↔ s < 1 := by
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

end ToroidalVolumeAudit

Decide the complete toroidal volume metric theorem (g:toroidal-volume), including all-valuation integrability, boundary extension, and conditional local strictness; a refutation must satisfy every hypothesis.
An explicit geometric counterexample to a literal toroidal-volume assertion satisfies all hypotheses of that assertion. This is a research obligation, not an assertion that a witness exists.

For every smooth connected projective complex variety X whose anticanonical bundle admits a smooth semipositive Hermitian metric, H^0(X,-mK_X) is nonzero for some integer m>0 (H, thm:headline). Alternative proofs are recorded as separate routes, not simultaneous prerequisites.

If Z is smooth connected projective with H^0(Z,Omega_Z^q)=0 for all q>0, D is effective integral, -K_Z+D has a semipositive singular metric with finite canonical-section measure, and L has locally bounded semipositive weights, then H^0(Z,aL+bD) is nonzero for some integers a>0,b>=0 (H, thm:finite-volume).

The finite-adjoint-volume slope estimate used in H controls cotangent determinants on a supporting movable class and permits the dimension induction; this is a source-specific audit obligation, not an assumed consequence of nefness.

The H orbit-transfer argument produces a naturally torus-invariant section of a positive anticanonical multiple on its smooth no-positive-forms factor, using invariant adjoint ranks and compact averaging rather than the full-rank volume theorem.
The finite-cover compact-torus-monodromy structure in H retains the deck action on the universal-cover factors; it is not a global-product assertion for a finite cover.
A nonzero section of a positive tensor power of a pulled-back line on a finite etale cover gives a nonzero section of a positive tensor power on the base by the finite etale norm.

For a holomorphic action of a compact real torus T on a compact complex manifold F and the natural anticanonical linearization, I_T(m)=sum_q(-1)^q dim H^q(F,(-K_F)^m)^T agrees with a rational polynomial P at every positive multiple of some a>0, and P(0)=I_T(0); no positivity, Kahlerness, or projectivity is assumed (I, thm:index).

If S is smooth connected projective, L=-K_S is smoothly semipositive, D is a fixed pseudoeffective Cartier divisor, and H^0(S,m_jL-D) is nonzero along a strictly increasing positive sequence, then H^0(S,kL) is nonzero for some k>0 (I, thm:conversion).

For a projective Q-factorial klt pair (W,D) with effective rational boundary, nef P=-(K_W+D), and a smooth projective resolution rho on which rho^*P has locally bounded semipositive weights and chi(O) is nonzero, a positive Cartier multiple of P has a nonzero section (B, thm:klt).

If Z is smooth rationally connected projective and -K_Z is smoothly semipositive, every algebraic torus acting on Z has a naturally invariant section of some positive anticanonical multiple (B, thm:equivariant). Its stable-quotient metric and extension are separate obligations from toroidal volume.

For smooth connected projective X with smoothly semipositive L=-K_X and an algebraic torus action, let P=L as ordinary lines with any linearization and let M be linearized with -M pseudoeffective. Nonzero invariant sections of M+iP for an unbounded positive set of i imply a nonzero invariant section of mP for some m>0 (C, inj:transfer).

For the C harmonic mechanism, f:V->Y is a surjective morphism of smooth projective varieties, D_V has a smooth semipositive metric whose null directions are vertical on a nonempty submersion open, and Q has a continuous semipositive metric on Y. Then H^p(Y,R^q f_*(K_V+D_V) tensor Q^k)=0 for p>0 and q,k>=0. This is an alternative mechanism, not an input to g:toroidal-volume.

Let X,Y be smooth connected projective complex varieties with dim Y>0, L=-K_X smoothly semipositive, p:W->X projective birational, and f:W->Y projective surjective equidimensional toroidal for strict embeddings, with W normal integral. For a smooth resolution rho:Z->W, pi=p rho, g=f rho, E_Z=K_{Z/X}, assume rank g_*O_Z(E_Z)=1. Set a_Q=max(0,min_{E->Q}((1+ord_E K_{W/X})/ord_E f^*Q-1)), A_0=sum a_Q Q. Then A_0 is finite effective rational, f^*A_0 is p-exceptional, and -K_Y+A_0 has a semipositive singular metric with unweighted locally integrable squared frame norms, smooth on a nonempty Zariski open. If pi^*alpha>=c g^*omega_Y on a nonempty ordinary patch in the smooth base-change locus away from E_Z, the constructed metric is strictly positive on a nonempty ordinary base open (G, g:toroidal-volume).

Under the morphism and model hypotheses of g:toroidal-volume, but without a metric or rank assumption, Theta=-K_{W/X}+f^*A_0 is nonpositive, (W,Theta) is sub-klt, and f^*A_0 is p-exceptional. Every prime F on every smooth model tau:Z'->W has coeff_F(K_{Z'/X}-(f tau)^*A_0)>-1 (G, g:volume-subklt).

With the full generic adjoint rank at exponent zero equal to one, the Jacobian section identifies the entire smooth adjoint direct image with -K_Y on a smaller base-change open, and its L2 frame norm equals the pushed-forward smooth anticanonical volume density. Smooth direct-image positivity makes the negative logarithm psh; no arbitrary subline restriction is used.

The corrected weight Phi=-log H+sum a_Q log|t_Q|^2 extends psh across every omitted divisor using the minimizing transverse branch, then across codimension at least two by Hartogs removability; projection of the corrected upstairs measure and g:volume-subklt prove unweighted local integrability.

In g:toroidal-volume the single horizontal-curvature patch away from E_Z implies positive definite curvature of the smooth density metric on a nonempty ordinary base open, via the primitive-representative curvature formula, including the relative-dimension-zero case.

For g:transfer, two semipositive metrics, finite canonical-section volume, a rational relative section without horizontal poles on a normal equidimensional model, and the two explicitly assumed psh fiber functions produce a bounded base line metric and an integral controlled-pole adjoint measure. Full-rank-one and invariant-quotient sufficient conditions must not be conflated.

For any fixed line M, any centered discrete valuation v of C(X) or v=0, and effective integral N_j~m_j L+M with m_j->infinity, ell(N_j)=0 and v(N_j)/m_j->0, there is effective rational N~_Q L with v(N)=0 (V, V:exact).
